abstract: Data extracted from dynamic distributions for realworld applications lead to a phenomenon called concept drift. Term concept in “concept drift” primarily refers to an unseen dependency or correlation between input attributes and target variables. There are various factors responsible for the drift in the concept. Such as random noise, change in the distributions of incoming streaming data, variations in the dependency of target variable on input features. This hitch could encounter when the dependency and relationship between input data attributes and target variables would vary gradually. So, the model must be capable of processing this data efficiently and swiftly adapt to these variations. This paper presents an outline of the concept drift research field and provides a review of various kinds of approaches adopted by researchers for mitigating issues related to concept drift.

articleTitle: Quantum Supremacy: How far along are we on the journey?
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: At our current technological pace, it's become increasingly hard to make more compact classical computers. Proceeding with this as one of the motivations for developing quantum computers, recent years have seen a surge in interest and therefore investment in the field with aims to surpass the capabilities of its classical counterpart. The term quantum supremacy, although it gets thrown around quite often, is a very intricate concept. Assessing all its parts to establish a robust definition and foundational ground rules is crucial as we go further. Theoretically discussed wonders that can be achieved by quantum computer sounds promising-from the rapid acceleration in the development of artificial intelligence and cryptography to quantum chemistry and modelling chemical reactions. But how far do we need to go for it to become a reality? Are we there yet? All these questions arise as there have been claims of quantum supremacy which are contentious at the least. A major reason for worry is the intractability of quantum computers that makes sceptics wonder if it's a pursuit equivalent to chasing the wind. Quantum computers will not make classical computers obsolete is another view point which does hold water as quantum computers seem to be useful only in solving specific problems. Even though the endeavour for quantum supremacy is still ongoing, companies have also gravitated towards Quantum advantage. This paper lays out an idiosyncratic view of what we can achieve and what we already have.

articleTitle: Hysteresis Controller and Instantaneous Power Controller Based DPFC
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This method is simply a element it is family members that is most certainly new of versatile AC transmission techniques (FACTS), known as a distributed power flow controller (DPFC). DPFC arises from a unified power flow controller (UPFC). DPFC can be viewed as as UPFC aided by the general dc link removed. The active power trade between the shunt and series converters, which passes through the general dc reference in the UPFC, now passes through the power lines at 3rd harmonic frequency. DPFC works on the distributed FACTS (D-FACTS) concept, that will be to use several single-phase tiny converters in place of one large series that is three-phase in UPFC. A quantity this is certainly huge of converters offer redundancy, therefore enhancing the dependability associated with system. No highvoltage insulation is required between phases because d-FACTS transducers are single-phase and float general to the ground. Properly, the price of the DPFC system is lower than that of UPFC.DPFC has got the control that is same as UPFC, which include range impedance, transmission angle and bus voltage. Presented DPFC controller in this project based on the Hysteresis voltage controller based series controller, and direct axis and quadrature axis current controllers (based Shunt controllers) are used for control and design. The complete system is designed in the atmosphere of MATLAB-simulink software. System analysis and testing for the case of sag and swell event in the 415 V distribution system is performed in matlab simulink. The simulation results show that DPFC improves system performance during unbalanced loading conditions, including sagging and swelling conditions.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Method for Energy Efficient Secondary Grid Cluster Head Selection to Avoid Energy Holes in WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Energy efficiency in randomly deployed Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) is affected by high consumption of energy due to sensing, data transmission, propagation delay, coverage and, connectivity, resulting in energy depletion at the sensor nodes. In a multi-hop network, the nodes near to the sink will see a drop in energy at a faster rate leading to break in the connectivity chain, resulting in reconfiguration of the Network. This energy hole issue can reduce by employing energy-optimized clustering techniques and the best optimal cluster head selection based on the higher residual energy levels in the nodes. In this paper, Particle swarm optimization is used to select primary and secondary cluster head for grid Sectored-clustered network to overcome the energy hole problem to extend the network lifetime. Also, it is proposed to compare the performance of the developed energy aware grid clustering algorithm with modified sectoring, Grid Sectoring and Two cluster head selection methods with a best optimization technique.

articleTitle: FaceCognize: An approach to Face Recognition for low resolution image
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent times, with the rise of the digital surveillance system, there is abundant digital forensics in the form of CCTV footage which can be utilized for the task of recognizing individuals. But due to the image resolution and environmental conditions, most of the data is rendered futile. Our proposed system is specifically aimed at efficiently leveraging this low-quality data and utilize this data from CCTV or other sources to track the individual. This system comprises of up scaling the low-quality images, extracting and aligning the faces, converting them into a feature vector, and finally using linear separators to distinguish them. This system can not only play a very important role in tracking criminal for law enforcement but also have wide-ranging application in access control, security, finding a missing person, and tracking attendance. This paper was developed as part of the Cisco ThinQbator 2020 program which is a platform to share ideas and collaborate.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Applications for Lending and NPA Management
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Non-performing assets (NPAs) are among the top pain points for financial institutions. In recent times an alarming increase trend in the number of bad loans and nonperforming assets attributed critical mess in the Indian banking system. Especially in Public sector banks that seize more than 70% of the total customer in India hold maximum NPAs alternatively Private sector banks having fewer NPAs that is also seen in their balance sheet which shows year-on-year growth and profit but in few cases, these become very serious. NPAs beyond a certain level is a cause for concern which directly and indirectly touches almost all parts of the economy as it drastically impacts liquidity which gets blocked lending capacity of the financial sector. The lack of due attentiveness before and after loan reinforcement is the single major cause for soaring the level of NPAs in the country apart from the absence of a common database and lack of timely intervention on a red flag. “Prevention is better than cure” is an enduring maxim that applies equally well to the banking industry for combating the problem of NPAs. Financial disruptions in the banking sector aim to make them technologically robust so that every financial institution should be empowered to operate its activities in a risk-free environment and provide a cutting-edge risk management ecosystem. Disruptive technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) provides an uncovering opportunity to the banks to formulate new modus operandi to stay ahead of the competition. The research paper focuses to understand the role of AI to propel the Indian banking system into the next generation of banking and prevent possible NP As with realtime monitoring so that they could be acknowledged before it's becoming awful for banks. In this current unprecedented situation with the pandemic, real-time monitoring of transactions through AI in the loan portfolio will provide potent shells for banks to keep credit portfolios risk-free, reeling the impact of the situation, under check. AI predictive analytics enhanced the scope of providing real-time surveillance solutions to handle uncollectible bad loans with smarter NP A management.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Classifiers for Leaf Classification and Extraction of Medicinal Properties
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the relative efficiencies of image classifiers - namely, a K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN) classifier, a Support Vector Machine (SVM) and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in leaf classification. The primary purpose of classifying leaves is to identify local plant species commonplace in and around households so as to extract and derive utility from the medicinal properties associated with them (if any). The input image acquired from the user undergoes appropriate image processing, after which defining features of the leaf are extracted in the form of numerical feature vectors. These are used to train the SVM and the KNN, enabling them to perform multi-class classification of the genus and species of the plant. CNNs have been attracting considerable amounts of attention in the field of image processing. The principal characteristic is that classification by CNNs occurs sans feature extraction. Medicinal properties corresponding to the plant and their directions for use are web scraped from the internet. Traditionally, the medicinal properties of plants are held in high regard for the treatment of common ailments and enhancing general health. A striking feature of this study is to equip the general populace with awareness of these properties to derive the benefits of their utility. Comparing the performance of the classifiers mentioned above leads us to conclude that CNN yields the best results.

articleTitle: EDRA – An Emotional Health Detection And Recognition Assistant
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Mental Health and Physical Health together are equally responsible for the overall well-being of an individual. We often give a preference to what we see (the body) rather than what we feel (the mind), resulting in negligence of our mental health. Moreover, getting treated for a mental illness is something considered as “negative”; hence with the stigma against mental issues, people do not openly talk about it. Over the years, therapy has proved quite effective in ameliorating one's mental state, but it fails to meet the expense of every pocket. Therefore, we propose EDRA - a chatbot created in order to communicate with the user and provide an environment just like in therapy. This virtual therapy works with the help of two principal models, the Emotion Recognition System and Deep Neural Network Model. The Emotion Recognition System helps to recognize the mood/emotion of the user with the text input it receives from the user, and with the help of this emotion, the Deep Neural Network Model yields a relevant response. On termination of the conversation, a report of the user's mental state is formed, and accordingly, specific remedies are suggested to lighten the user's mood.

articleTitle: Demand forecasting and Route Optimization in Supply chain industry using Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Logistics industry is one of key pillars of the global economy, which involves interdisciplinary domains. Manufacturing companies need to devise strategies in order to deliver best-quality products on time, meeting customers' growing expectations is becoming increasingly important. Demand forecasting and route optimization are key challenges which needs to be solved because it is interdependent on Fleet usage, analyzing the safety stock, and last mile connectivity in large cities where the density of orders to be delivered is high and any miscalculation in the above two aspects will lead to a domino effect in the industry, where the losses are unacceptable. This paper leverages two important algorithms, one is time series analysis i.e. Auto regressive integrated moving average and simulated annealing algorithm for demand forecasting and route optimization respectively. Both the models help in addressing the key problems by formulating a solution by means of simulation and providing the best possible results, that can be directly incorporated in the industry for the benefit.

articleTitle: Virtual Inertia Controller for the Grid Interfacing Inverter of Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Today's power system comprises of conventional as well as non-conventional renewable sources like wind, solar etc. The integration of these renewable energy sources has resulted in a reduced inertia of the grid, which causes the frequency instability in the system. A novel controller whose functioning is similar to that of a synchronous generator has been designed. This controller is capable of extracting the kinetic energy stored in the blades of the wind turbine and maintain the required amount of inertia in the power grid as a result the frequency deviation problems are reduced. The enhancement in performance of the system in presence of this novel controller is tested under different cases such as sudden increase/decrease in large loads, faults etc.

articleTitle: Replication Scheme for Structured P2P System Applications in Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs)
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The popularity of P2P (Peer-To-Peer) systems is increased tremendously due to massive increase in the Internet based applications. Initially, P2P systems were mainly designed for wired networks but today people are using more wireless networks and therefore these systems are gaining popularity. There are many wireless networks available today and WMNs (Wireless Mess Networks) are gaining popularity due to hybrid structure. People are using structured P2P systems-based applications within perimeter of a WMN. Structured P2P WMNs will assist the community to fetch the relevant information to accomplish their activities. There are inherent challenges in the structured P2P network and increased in wireless environment like WMNs. Structured P2P systems suffer from many challenges like lack of content availability, malicious content distribution, poor search scalability, free riding behaviour, white washing, lack of a robust trust model etc. Whereas, WMNs have limitations like mobility management, bandwidth constraint, limited battery power of user's devices, security, maintenance etc. in remote/ forward areas. We exploit the better possibility of content availability and search scalability in this paper. We propose replication schemes based on the popularity of content for structured P2P system applications in community based WMNs. The analysis of the performance shows that proposed scheme performs better than the existing replication scheme in different conditions.

articleTitle: Classification of Multiple Myeloma Cancer Cells Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: An image processing based computer aided diagnostic tool for Multiple Myeloma cancer diagnosis was developed. Multiple Myeloma involves white blood cells in the bone marrow becoming cancerous, which can severely damage the bones and kidneys and cause death. We used 1451 images for our study from a recently publicly released dataset (SegPC-2021 Challenge) of stained microscope images which contained normal and cancerous cells. For the task of classifying images containing cancerous cells or not, we obtained a good classification accuracy of 93.58%, which was further improved using Transfer Learning and Fine Tuning with different pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks models, namely VGG (Visual Geometry Group), VGG-16, VGG-19, MobileNetV1, and MobileNetV2 that gave an accuracy of 94.00%, 95.50%, 99.90%, and 97% respectively.

articleTitle: Recommendation System for Farmers using Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Our work aims to address the gap in terms of lack of information with farmers in rural Karnataka by recommending markets at which they can reap the maximum monetary benefit for their produce. Decisions on which market to choose are highly dependent on the prices they can sell their produce at, coupled with the logistic costs to deliver their produce to the market. Providing the farming community with a solution that balances the tradeoff between the two factors to enable maximum profits will prove invaluable to an economy that is primarily agrarian. The purpose of the proposed method is two-fold - to determine which crop is the most beneficial to sell, and at which market will prove to be the most profitable. This application uses real time data to fulfill two use cases - namely recommendation of crops and recommendation of markets to farmers using a simple interface, which is available in the local language.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Hybrid Power Electronic AC-AC Voltage Controller Comprising Phase Angle and Integral Cycle Control Techniques for Heating Application in Oxide Chlorination Furnace
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Oxide chlorination is done in sponge production facility to produce anhydrous Zirconium tetra chloride, preferred intermediate for production of nuclear reactor grade Zirconium sponge. Thermodynamically Zirconium oxide (ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) is more stable than Zirconium tetra chloride (ZrCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>). Thus, the change in free energy being positive reaction is not possible. Hence, to make the reaction possible, carbon in the form of coked briquettes are fed in oxide chlorinator furnace along with ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Chlorine is passed from furnace bottom and reaction takes place with better chlorine utilization when chlorine comes in contact with coked briquettes at a temperature of around 1000°C approx. After carbon addition, reaction is only slightly exothermic. Thus, to meet the heat loss and sustain the reaction, bed has to be heated externally. The external heating is accomplished through the self resistant nature of bed by circulating AC current through the bed with the help of three graphite electrodes, placed 120° apart. Conventionally the supply voltage to graphite electrodes is controlled by using an auto transformer with the help of increase/decrease push buttons, which is an open loop system. Major difficulty in this method is due to uncertainty in the increase of carbon conductivity with rising temperature, as current increases to about 800 to 900 Amps, both during preheating and also after chlorine injection. Because of this phenomenon, graphite electrodes are prone to get damaged. To mitigate the issue and maintain a temperature within 700°C range, it is proposed to implement power electronic AC-AC voltage controller with bidirectional semiconductor devices which detects the current and adjust the voltage automatically in closed loop system. However, harmonic attenuation is utmost important in the improvement of power quality. The paper aims to design a combination of both phase angle control and integral cycle control techniques to generate maximum fundamental component and minimum harmonic content to meet IEEE:519-2014 guidelines. The type of control technique is decided by the process as well as incoming power quality parameters. During preheating of bed, integral cycle control is used to obtain gradual voltage reduction in steps as process time constant is high. After preheating, chlorination reaction initiates, increasing temperature due to exothermic nature of reaction and changing nature of the bed with current changes suddenly. To meet the requirements, fast and fine control of voltage is necessary which is achieved by using phase angle control. The simulation results showing generation of gate trigger pulses for both the techniques has been presented.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Real Time Mechanism using Advanced Real-Coded Genetic Algorithm in LTE Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the contemporary communications landscape, the proliferation of high-end mobile devices has increased the number of users, necessitating increased bandwidth, which can be efficiently processed using the well-known technique known as Long Term Evolution (LTE). Furthermore, with scattered devices and dynamic radio propagation conditions, the LTE standard should deliver high-speed data services. The main difficulty in the communication network is how to properly handle the growing data load. As a result, important factors such efficient load balancing with a higher rate of throughput and scalability must be taken into account. With this in mind, the purpose of this paper is to build a Dynamic Load Balancing Mechanism using an Advanced Real-Coded Genetic Algorithm (DLBM-ARGA). Advanced Real-Coded Genetic Algorithm focuses on the ideal base station and coverage configuration in the proposed study. When the findings are compared to existing approaches, it is discovered that the proposed model is more efficient.

articleTitle: Media File Descriptor Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Media files like audios and videos are very useful sources of information, entertainment etc. Humans watch/listen to media files almost everyday for some purpose or another. There are lots of videos,audio and images on every content on the internet and other platforms. Sometimes, just the title can be misleading and humans end up utilizing time on irrelevant media files and often when they realize this isn't the relevant media file they have already wasted some time. Our Media File Descriptor is a generalized platform used to provide a summary of any media file that is audio, video or image quickly so that the user has optimum information of the media file beforehand by reading the summary and can decide if the file is relevant to what they are looking for. If not, the user doesn't end up wasting time on the wrong media file.

articleTitle: An Overview of Technological Revolution in Deep Learning Architectures for Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The research publications related to biomedical domain are increasing and a huge information is concealed in it. Most of these information are available in the unstructured format and it is not available in ready-to-use format for further experiments and analysis. Several techniques and features of Information Extraction (IE) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Text Mining (TM) are used in the field of biomedical domain. The main purpose of this paper is to review the various research works / practices which are being carried out, especially in the Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (BioNER) domain. Application of NLP in BioNER helps to extract knowledge on various entities like drug, disease, chemical, cell, gene, protein, etc. In this paper, a survey on BioNER which includes traditional rule-based methods, statistical Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) has been carried out to get key insights on research works in this area. This review proves that the DL models took over statistical ML and rule-based systems and proved to be the state-of-the-art in various perspectives.

articleTitle: DeepTracking from Aerial Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Object tracking is a pivotal part of video processing. Defense based UAVs generally fly at an altitude of 20,000-30,000ft. Conventionally, it's quite easy to track objects from a stationary camera's feed. Videos from UAVs are hard to process beca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>use of abrupt motion of the UAV, jitters, noise and cluttering produced in the video. Tracking and surveillance from such altitudes is quite challenging. This paper illustrates the combination of mod- ified YOLOv4 algorithm with Darknet framework to perform object detection and the DeepSORT tracker to perform object tracking in such challenging environments. The detection model achieves an 11% improvement in Mean Average Precision(mAP) when compared with its predecessors on custom images. When paired with DeepSORT and inferred on a high-end GPU it renders output at 28 FPS, making it suitable for real-time tracking. It is also immune to occlusion and camera movement. The proposed model addresses problems in the existing models that require manual locking of target and high computational complexity. In addition to this, it aims to illustrate automatic tracking of moving objects in real-time.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Based Image Steganography Method using Cyclic Chaos and Integer Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Steganography is the technique of hiding confidential information inside a cover in order to deceive attackers. Neural Networks (NN) become very popular and effective to train a model and get accurate result. In this article we used unsupervised NN to select and train model for cover image selection. Chaotic structures and transformation techniques like the integer wavelet transform in Steganography have good result due to minimum data loss. In this paper, we propose a cyclic chaos algorithm that produces Pseudorandom Number Generator (PRNG), use seeds for embedding purpose. We also used the Integer Wavelet Transform (IWT) to minimize data loss and return a high-quality encoded image. Our proposed system can embed colored image. Furthermore, evident and easily understandable as well as executable. We found that our approach outperforms other recent steganography approaches in terms of improved embedding time, reduced complexity, and improved decoded image quality with increased hiding capability.

articleTitle: Design of a Wideband mm Wave Massive MIMO Antenna for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A co-planar waveguide (CPW) fed stub loaded slot antenna is designed and is stretched to ten elements multiple input and multiple output (MIMO) for mm wave 5G communication system in this paper. It covers a wide band (22.9-28.8 GHz) of Millimeter wave (mm wave) and the stub loading technique is used to achieve desirable 5G frequency spectrum (24.2-27 GHz) with proper impedance matching. The fractional bandwidth is almost 22.8%. The |S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>| and isolation characteristics of the proposed MIMO antenna are below -20 dB which indicates good impedance matching with significantly low mutual coupling between the adjacent elements. The diversity performances such as envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) is below 0.0004 and Channel capacity Loss (CCL) is below 0.1 bps/Hz over the entire bandwidth. The system is developed using ten elements antenna and the overall layout area is 1.37 λ X 6.88 λ. The compactness of the MIMO system and antenna characteristics imply that the proposed design can be a promising structure for future 5G mm wave communication system.

articleTitle: Distributed Data Management Ecosystem for Intelligent Transportation Systems using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Blockchain systems are known for their trustless multi-party transaction systems. Possessing properties such as immutability, transparency, data consistency and consensus based updation, blockchain has become a very important decentralized tool for applications that are time sensitive and require security. The purpose of this paper is to explore how we can apply blockchain technology solutions to Intelligent transportation systems(ITS) with a data management perspective. We propose an ecosystem architecture for such ITS applications and dive deep into distributed data management concepts involved in each layer of the architecture. We examine the flow of data in blockchain based ITS applications of the proposed architecture. Finally we have also provided a use-case scenario.

articleTitle: Design of MIMO based Quad Antenna for Efficient Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the design of latest wireless devices more emphasis has been put on the miniaturization of antennas accompanying efficiency. Patch antennas have found a huge scope in this evolving era of technology. The high data rate and least fading requirement has paved the way for the MIMO antenna technology. This paper presents four element patch antenna which operates in three frequency bands between 2GHz and 6 GHz. The four elements are placed orthogonally with respect to each other's orientation on the square space giving it a quad antenna configuration. The design proposed takes into account the effect of spatial and polarization diversity technique for common return loss and good isolation between different ports. The result shows VSWR of less than 2 dB and has more than 10dB of isolation is obtained between any of the ports of respective antenna elements.

articleTitle: Comparision of Short Term Load Forecast Techniques using Univariate Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The load in the power system has become so dynamic these days that needs sophisticated technology to monitor and control the power system. Load forecast shares a major responsibility in doing so. It helps in unit commitment to the grid and also in proper planning of the infrastructure. Even a minute error in the load forecast may cost so much both in terms of finance and reliability. So, it is imperative for electrical engineers to equip the latest methodologies in accurately predicting the demand well in advance. Although the prediction of demand was first talked about way back in 1925, it has seen a major push with the introduction of statistical methods. In recent years, Artificial Intelligence has brought another major shift in restricting the error margin to trivia, thereby precisely predicting the demand. But, out of the various algorithms and methodologies available, it is important to choose the better model with better accuracy and ease of deploying. In this paper, the authors compare as many as 4 different methodologies to conclude the best fit model for a precise short-term load forecast using univariate data. The prediction has been performed using Triple Exponential Smoothing, Explicit Multi Seasonality, Artificial Neural Network, and Long Short-Term Memory techniques.

articleTitle: Stress Detection: A Predictive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: One of the unavoidable consequences of today's fast lifestyle is work pressure and excessive mental stress. This is eventually leading to fatal consequences since people are comparatively reluctant to accept the severity of the disease, often being unaware of its symptoms. This paper suggests a non-invasive system to track your stress levels and alerts in advance if any such trend is noticed. The three symptoms forming the base of the research are tendency of the person to be “scared” or “sad”, tendency of drowsiness due to lack of sleep and an alarming increased heart rate at difficult situations. Stress level and aspect ratio parameters are detected from video processing and real-time heart rate values are plotted to implement the same. The system was successfully found to detect these trends and hence can be considered for stress detection function. Heart rate, being one of the immediate parameters indicating stress, its value is also stored in cloud for trend observation.

articleTitle: Remote Controlled Solar Chargeable Patrolling Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Increasing numbers of crimes around the globe have created a demand for high level of safety and security. At the same time with the fast paced world there has been a requirement to reduce human effort. Many people are increasingly approaching solutions offered by technology to tackle this. Our project aims at introducing a product in the market that not only ensures security of a bounded area, but also focuses on safety and right to privacy by maintaining a highly secure data storage system. Designed and realized in this project, the robot is equipped with a camera and Ultrasonic sensors. This is done with the help of a Raspberry Pi and Wi-Fi module.

articleTitle: Wellhead Surveillance and Shutdown System Using SIL Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Safety is best achieved by an inherently safe process design. IEC 61508 and IEC 61511 safety standards are followed to design the safe wellhead surveillance and shutdown panel application. Safety Integrity Level (SIL) controller is used to develop the system as it has its own advantages in case of safety. Block diagram and flow of wellhead surveillance and shutdown is explained. Functional block diagram programming is used to develop the control logic with the help of advanced control system based on Distributed Control System (DCS).

articleTitle: Loop shaping control of DC-DC Forward Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A DC-DC converter's main purpose is to produce constant DC output voltage. In this paper steady-state and small-signal analysis of Forward Converter(FC) is written to get the transfer function of FC. To improve the performance of the Forward Converter(which is a minimum phase system), the controller is designed using a graphical loop shaping technique with the help of a bode magnitude plot. The proposed control method is compared with the modified Ziegler-Nichols(Z-N) method and analysis the step response, bode plot, and Nyquist plot. The loop shaping comparatively reduces the overshoot and rise time of a system. The stability analysis of a open loop and closed loop FC system are accomplished through MATLAB/SIMULINK platform.

articleTitle: Falsified News Detection Using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Technology is changing the way that we live our lives. With the advances in technology, Social Media attains a lot of attention from the people around us. With the advancement of technology, fake news with both political or commercial motives is growing very fast on the internet. Users might be affected easily by falsified news, which has brought about mammoth effects on humanity. The foremost goal is to stop the spread of rumors and focus on the true, substantiate news columns. This paper focuses on techniques such as training deep learning neural network models and natural language processing (NLP) techniques for text analytics based on news titles or news content. These techniques can be used for the treatment of the data. Some of the treating steps are tokenizing the input, lemmatizing it, Stemming and removal of irrelevant words (stop words) are done prior to converting them into N-gram vectors using a technique known as TF-IDF that is term frequency-inverse document frequency. With the help of Machine learning and natural language processing, we will try to aggregate the news and later determine whether the news is real or fake using deep neural networks. Experimental evaluation yields the simplest performance using Term Frequency-Inverted Document Frequency (TF-IDF) as a feature extraction technique.

articleTitle: Automatic Syntax Error Correction
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Correcting syntax errors in programming languages is not easy. The presence of false positives in the error report makes it more problematic. We have developed a tool that filters the spurious errors and gives suggestions to correct syntax errors. Our method is language agnostic. We operate on the grammar of the programming language. The algorithm that suggests corrections considers all changes that can be made at the location of the error and tries to produce corrections that prevent subsequent spurious errors and allow minimal change to input as possible. Our tool provides the user with a Graphical User Interface that shows suggested repairs and allows the programmer to apply them.

articleTitle: Area Efficient Approximate Constant-or Adder
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Power consumption and speed have been well determined with the help of arithmetic module, adder. So the need of high speed, error tolerance and power efficiency nature of few applications have been improved the development of approximate adders. To increase the effectiveness of integrated circuits, utilizing the tradeoff between accuracy and cost of hardware has a great potential. Various approximate adders have been proposed using this technique. By using systematic methodology, optimizing the architecture for approximate adders have been implemented. The adder is called optimized lower part constant-OR adder (LOCA). The adder has been proposed by redesigning its logic circuit.

articleTitle: Automatic Image Colorization with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Image colorization is the procedure of adding RGB color space value to the original greyscale image. Greyscale Image carries only the intensity information at each pixel value. This intensity mostly varies from 0 to 256 which is just enough to observe a gradual change in intensity. Image colorization is a very crucial process and has many benefits of its own for example in medical science, the entertainment industry, and the study of scientific and astrological images etc. We have developed a CNN model in which we designed our own CNN layers that takes a greyscale image as input and returns a colored image as output. The model proposed here does not require any human interaction in the process of colorization of the image once it is fed to the neural network.

articleTitle: A Compact CPW Fed Artistry Bell shaped WLAN Reject Stable UWB- MIMO Diversity Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A Coplanar Waveguide fed compact band notched Ultrawideband two-port Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna is presented. Antenna has a novel artistry bell shaped radiators and a defected ground structure (DGS). The antenna of size 15mm × 30mm × 0.8mm is having exact ultrawideband ranging from 3 GHz to 10.6 GHz. Improved isolation of -21 dB is noticed within the band except higher frequency band from 9.5 GHz to 10.6 GHz, where it is in the allowable range of less than -15dB. Radiators are placed at 180° from each other providing high isolation. No other decoupling technique has been utilized. Notched band for WLAN (5.1 GHz to 5.8 GHz) is obtained by adding L-shaped slit on the radiator. Radiation Efficiency of more than 90% is achieved. MIMO Diversity parameters are procured and improved channel capacity is achieved within desired band.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Energy Harvester using GPS L1 Band for Small Power Battery Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Paper describes the simulation model of energy harvesting of the 1575.42 MHz band (GPS L1 Band). Increase in pollution caused by the non renewable energy sources can be reduced by making use of renewable energy sources such as solar, mechanical vibration, thermal, microwave signals etc. There are multiple harvester circuits readily available in market but still rapid inventions are in progress. Harvested energy is used for charging of the battery operated system which has low power consumption. Inset feed patch antenna designed to receive the signal at 1575.42 MHz band. Rectifier and multiplier circuit is designed using Dickson voltage circuit and tested for the input power ranging from -10 dBm to +20 dBm. Matching circuit between antenna (RF 50 Ω line) and rectifier circuit is designed for efficient power transmission. Output of the rectifier is fed to the super capacitor which acts as an energy reservoir for the preceding stage. All the simulation is carried over in Keysight ADS and LtSpice XVII. Overall system efficiency of 35% is achieved in this work. Designed antenna has achieved gain of 3.127 dBi, directivity of 6.145, efficiency of 46.66% and return loss of 11.045 dB. Designed matching network inserted between antenna and rectifier has achieved a return loss of 25 dB. Harvesting system is verified for the input power ranging from -10 dB to +15 dB and load ranging from 100Ω to 30 kΩ.

articleTitle: User Grouping and Imperfect CSI for Downlink NOMA over κ- µ Fading
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The massive increase in the utilization of mobile devices and communication networks has increased the requirement of massive connectivity and efficient spectrum utilization. Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) technique has been a promising technology towards the present day requirements of the users. In NOMA, the signals are superimposed with different power levels for each user and then transmitted to the receiver. The receiver performs Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) to distinguish and obtain the required signal. Till now, various researches have focused on SIC with perfect characteristics whereas only few research focused on imperfect SIC (ipSIC). While perfect SIC (pSIC) acts an ideal case of no loss of information and external noises, the ipSIC acts as practical scenario of data transmission in real-time environment. In this paper, we aim to obtain the performance metrics of the considered NOMA system in presence of ipSIC and compare to the performance of pSIC of the same user. More importantly, we characterize channels as κ - µ fading distribution. We derive closed-form expressions of outage probability for two destinations. Meanwhile, we also perform the Monte-Carlo simulations to check the authenticity of obtained mathematical expressions.

articleTitle: Penta Band High Gain 8-Element Antenna Array for Multiband Applications at Higher Microwave Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Analysis of the 8-element antenna array is presented in this paper. A power divider circuit is designed to provide an equal amount of power to each element. The microstrip line with open-end is used as a monopole with the defected ground plane. This defected ground plane is used as an aperture structure underneath the monopole to achieve multiband performance. The proposed antenna is offering good radiation characteristics at five bands. A model of the antenna array is fabricated, and experimental results validate the analysis.

articleTitle: Controlling Transmission Line Power Parameters By Using UPFC
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: FACTS devices expands the range of options aimed at controlling power delivery along with increasing capacity of current and new lines. The UPFC(unified power flow controller) is a highly complex power electronic interface that could regulate a voltage bus(local) along with optimize power flow in an electric drive system at the same time. By connecting the UPFC at the transmitting and receiving ends, this paper shows how to manage actual as well as reactive(VAR) power flow across the transmission channels. Main aim is to figure out how to monitor and perform a UPFC that will be installed at the transmission line to control complex power flow. Complex power via the transmission line cannot managed if no UPFC is mounted. To test the UPFC's results, simulations are run in the Matlab/Simulink setting.

articleTitle: Automatic Welding and Soldering Machine Using PLC in Automobile Application
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Automation, the word leads to automatic control of any process, no matter whatsoever be the field. It is the most useful and productive idea for any interaction. In this modern era, they are somehow managing their work forces. Addition of automation would be very much beneficial. This machine will do appropriate work regarding the Industrial Automation Welding and soldering concept. This can be done with the help of a good and reliable Automatic robot which controls by the program of PLC. It consists of mainly “Welding” operation in it, so it can easily be done in the Industries for the whole line weld and also solder operation quickly and accurate by this. It is basically a two in one Automatic process machine which have some Electronic control also deals with Mechanical control for the Automobile application. The AUTOMATION WELDING AND SOLDERING MACHINE USING PLC is to provide the maintain quality and quantity, increasing productivity, reducing cost, increasing safety in work place and the time saving, reduce process parameter. Likewise, as per the other devices which is suitable for the Welding and Soldering Purpose that are just an individual bases, whereas this device comprises the Two-Way Technology in One Compact Robot for the Soldering and Welding Purpose to Make it very Precise, Time Saving and have greater Accurate in an output.

articleTitle: A Frequency Reconfigurable Printed Antenna using PIN Diode for Mobile Terminal Application
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A frequency reconfigurable patch antenna using p-i-n diode is proposed. The antenna switches at four different frequencies between 4.4 GHz and 4.7 GHz. The design includes a pair of PIN diodes in the slot for frequency switching operation. The antenna (34X36Xl.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) is designed on an FR4 substrate using HFSS software. The performance of the antenna is demonstrated through return loss, radiation pattern, gain and effienicy. The simulation results show that the antenna exhibits an average gain 7.3 dBi and effienicy of 95 %. The proposed antenna may be suitable for modern multifunctional mobile terminal application.

articleTitle: Smart Irrigation System using IoT based Control Valve
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: For over decades, the traditional irrigation methods are ditch irrigation, sprinkler system, and drip irrigation. The traditional irrigation systems have uncontrolled irrigation practices, waterlogging, soil deterioration, wastage of water and require continuous human intervention leading to higher usage of electricity and uneven growth of plants. Introducing IoT solutions enables precise crop watering and results in increased productivity with low maintenance, optimal use of resources, and enables future harm prediction. A new sophisticated approach minimizes the problem by connecting one mother/feeder pipe to various child pipes which in turn covers the entire area for watering. The IoT -enabled control valve boxes are mounted covering a range of half-kilometer area. The system is solar-operated without the requirement of an external battery that can sustain under unfavorable conditions.

articleTitle: Anegoo - No Pain, Only Gain
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Anaemia is the most prevalent nutritional deficiency disorder in the world that affects all age groups particularly preschool-age children and pregnant women. WHO estimates that 42% of children less than five years of age and 40% of pregnant women worldwide are anaemic. So, it is important to monitor one's haemoglobin levels regularly. Generally people don't tend to go to hospitals for regular check-ups until it's a serious issue and people living in remote areas do not have easy access to diagnostic centres and also invasive methods are painful. If one buys a device, the device maintenance would cost more than the actual device's cost. So, an app called “ANEGOO” is being designed using image processing that collects users basic details and predicts haemoglobin values, suggests precautions accordingly, along with a data logger to compare previous values, within seconds, at any point of time with very good accuracy.

articleTitle: Activity Identification using Supervised Machine Learning on Wearable Activity Tracker Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Wearable activity trackers are electronic devices which are used to monitor fitness, sleep and other physical activities. The popularity of these devices is increasing as their capability to identify and track different type of activities has grown while at the same time they continue to become more affordable. This paper evaluates several machine learning techniques to improve our ability to accurately predict various physical activities like lying, sitting, walking and running using data tracked by such activity trackers. The dataset includes 3656 of Apple Watch and 2608 minutes of Fitbit data. The results show that an XGBoost model achieved the maximum AUC of 0.98 for the Apple Watch dataset, 0.99 on the Fitbit dataset, and 0.98 on the combined dataset.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Energy Harvesting using Piezoelectric Discs
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Presently there has been an increased demand for energy as conventional sources of energy is going to reduce rapidly. It leads to create a high demand for energy sources and everybody knows that these sources are limited in the environment. So here require to think about other sources of energy and need to go with it while keeping in mind, that it should not affect human life. Various sources of energy conservation methods produce noise, air and water pollution, etc. The implementation of this also to be cost-effective. In this scope, piezoelectric discs become good for energy harvesting and storage for future applications. It takes advantage of the energy generated when people walking on it. This converts it into electric energy which used in an electronic gadget that requires power. This research paper is based on a new approach to solving the above problems by introducing here an Internet of things based energy harvesting system using piezoelectric discs. Which are capable to drive energy to electronic devices from stored energy in the battery. This setup is just not only harvested the energy although anyone can see the energy-saving related parameters voltage, current, battery level. It is also able to handle functions like mobile charging station application with the help of an Internet of thing based android application remotely in contrast with smart cities. Designing and implementing work is done for a real-time prototype system and tested for energy harvesting.

articleTitle: Topic Classification using Active Learning for Sinhala Language Documents
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the field of Classifying Text data, Text Classification and Topic Modeling plays the higher role. When compared between the two techniques, Text Classification provides outputs with higher accuracy level. Due to this Data analysts tend to move towards this technique. Text classification is also referred to as text categorization/tagging, and it is a task of categorizing text according to its specified class. Text classifiers can automatically examine a set of text and classify it under a pre-defined category according to the content of the set of text with the help of Natural Language Processing (NLP) [1]. As this is a Supervised learning, it requires a vast range of classified dataset to make the classification efficient. But when it comes to languages with scarcity of classified dataset such as Sinhala, it becomes a problem to train the model due to the insufficiency of the dataset. Thus, the author proposes a solution for performing Text classification using Active learning. This solution utilizes the available classified dataset, learns from this supervised model, and produces outcomes (Classified Text Data) with a high accuracy level.

articleTitle: Performance of Supercapacitor in Correcting the Power Quality Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In practice power system network is composing miscellaneous loads with different magnitude and nature. The nature of the loads is either lagging in nature or non-linear in nature. The very common characteristics of the non-linear devices are modern semi-conductor technology type and these devices cause some impact on the network. The integration of the Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) is corrects the issues raised and it avoids the need of installing extra device. The supercapacitor implementation results in correcting the voltage profile and reduces the harmonic content of the system.

articleTitle: A Brief Revolution of Evolution and Resurgence on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The most prominent branch of Artificial intelligence is Machine learning, experiencing exponential growth in almost all fields over the decades. It's been a very challenging journey for computer scientists and researchers from many decades to sustain and achieve stability so far in this particular field. This paper intends to present an overview of machine learning, from its origin, its incessant evolution through these decades. This review helps the researchers and data scientists to gain insight and foster the scholarly discussions of the achievements of AI and ML, it also provides a proper perspective on obtained results for all the researches intended to explore machine learning.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake News related to COVID-19 using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: There have been a rampant spread of fake news during the COVID-19 pandemic. Unverified cures generated from fake news pose a threat to public health. The hoax messages can downplay the seriousness of the situation leading to a subsequent ignorance of basic guidelines like masks mandates and social distancing. Hence, it is necessary to curb the spread of such news and misinformation which can cause public harm. This paper proposes a counteractive measure to mitigate the aforementioned fake news by constructing a dataset compiled from verified fact-checking websites and news resources. In this paper, Machine Learning algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, etc. and Deep Learning models such as Recurrent Neural Networks have been applied to the dataset and trained models provide promising benchmark results.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection and Classification System Design: Towards Better Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The figure of road accidents is rapidly growing across the world. Among many other factors, driver's drowsiness is one of the prime sources of such crashes. In drowsy state, the decision taking capability and alertness level of the human brain decreases which results in the accident. In order to control such accidents, the drowsy condition of the driver has to be identified in advance. An Electroencephalogram (EEG) based drowsiness monitoring and alarming system by extracting DWT (Discrete Wavelet Transform) features for higher accuracy is presented here. The scope of the paper is to extend the concept into a smart IoT device with ability to generate alert and classify drowsy state of driver using wavelet transform. The system is tested on 60 subjects in both awake and drowsy states by applying ANN (Artificial Neural Network) and KNN (K Nearest Neighbour) algorithms. Using six training functions on ANN algorithms, accuracy of 90%, sensitivity of 95% and specificity of 90% is achieved. Similarly, the best results from KNN algorithm are the accuracy of 94.92%, sensitivity of 93.10% and specificity of 94.92%.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Subspace Detection and Classification of Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Classifying hyperspectral images is a challenging task as it contains high data volume and the required spectral signatures is not available always. Therefore, the classification process faces curse of dimensionality problem. However, it is very useful in many applications after successful classification since it contains a lot of useful information about the ground objects. This complicacy can be overcome by reducing the irrelevant features before image classification. From the large input dataset, the required information can be extracted by Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Therefore, to address the aforementioned problem, PCA is applied in this thesis to reduce the input dimensionality as well as improve the classification accuracy. For appraising the efficacy of the proposed method real hyperspectral data was used and this data was also used to perform the experimental analysis. The selected subspace was evaluated using different classifiers for performing the experimental results. From the result it can be said that on real hyperspectral data, the proposed approach can achieve about 99% as training accuracy and 97% as testing or classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Stock Market Trend Analysis on Indian Financial News Headlines with Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Predicting the stock movement in the real-time scenario has been the most challenging and sophisticated in business. This business is affected by several factors from physical to psychological as well as rational to irrational. So far only few aspects have been taken into account while breaking down the conclusion. Implementing sentiment analysis, a subfield of Natural Language Processing (NLP), from the news, social media or financial document, investors decide whether they should invest for the company. The results have shown a significant and a feasible method for predicting the stock market trend with higher accuracy. The current research has mainly focus on finding the sentiment score from the news headlines and finding the hidden trend from it. Further the trading signals are generated based on the prevailing trend and trends are executed by the automated trading system. Using this algorithm, traders can reduce the manual intervention in the buy and sell decisions related to the stock market.

articleTitle: Comparison of Server Load Balancing Techniques in Cloud Simulated Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The performance of cloud services depends on the scheduling algorithms that distribute the incoming network traffic among their servers to achieve effectiveness in execution of tasks. These algorithms assign the tasks to various computing resources which are virtual in nature. In a cloud environment, assigning tasks to corresponding resources is NP-hard in nature. The traditional scheduling algorithms like FCFS, SJF, and Round Robin etc. will not be suitable to solve NP-hard scheduling problems. Cloud scheduling considers various criteria like resource utilization, cost, makespan and throughput. In this paper, cloud scheduling algorithms such as Max-Min Algorithm, Min-Min Algorithm, Enhanced Max-Min Algorithm and Greedy algorithms for server load balancing in cloud environments are implemented. The paper concludes with the comparative analysis of these algorithms.

articleTitle: A New Swarm-Based Improved FCM Clustering Algorithm for Efficient Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Image segmentation is a procedure in which an image is classified into different regions such that each region has the same features and distinctive characteristics. In the same segment, the pixels have similar characteristics whereas pixels which belong to different segments have significant variances. The division of the image into meaningful regions helps to make analysis easier and more effective. This is used in many applications including health care, pattern recognition, satellite imaging, etc. Clustering is a widely implemented unsupervised technique used for image segmentation mainly because of its easiness and fast computation and the Fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering algorithm is among the most widely utilized for segmentation, however, there are certain weaknesses of the algorithm such as sensitivity to arbitrary initial values, and falling easily into a local optimum solution. To solve these limitations of standard FCM, various hybrid segmentation techniques have been proposed. In this paper, a new swarm based modified FCM algorithm for image segmentation is proposed. The proposed approach blends Dynamic Particle Swarm Optimization (DPSO) with FCM which enhanced the performance of FCM algorithm mainly because of the global optimization capability and parallel computing capability of DPSO. The values of inertia weight changes dynamically together with the fitness function. The proposed methodology to image segmentation is tested using various images and is compared with other existing conventional segmentation approaches by considering different evaluation parameters to determine the feasibility of the proposed schemes and experimental finding validates the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Towards Multi-Objective ARQIEA for Solving Economic Load Dispatch and Emission Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Economic Dispatch problem is just not related to minimizing the cost of power generation but also correlates with environmental pollution issues. The major part of generating units is fossil fuel-based and releases different kinds of pollutant gases. Every day a huge amount of fossil fuel is used in thermal power plants and a bulk amount of harmful gases are released into the environment. The thermal units based on fossil fuels are one of the main causes of air pollution and global warming. To overcome this issue many researchers proposed different solution methods. The present work is also focused on the solution of environmental/economic load dispatch. It is also called Economic Emission Load Dispatch (EELD). Evolutionary Algorithms (EAs) are the most popular solution technique adopted by researchers to solve mix-integer, non-linear and complex problems. EAs suffer from premature convergence and lack of diversity issues. The present work proposed an Adaptive Real Coded Quantum Inspired Evolutionary algorithm (ARQiEA) to solve the multi-objective EED problem. The constraints are satisfied using a repair-based constraint handling method. The proposed algorithm provided efficient and improved results during the test on IEEE 30 Bus system including six generators and the results are compared with well-known techniques and found competitive than others.

articleTitle: Effect of the Video Frame Rate on the Precision of Detecting Circular Fidgety Movements Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cerebral Palsy (CP) is the most common disability of childhood. Early diagnosis of CP is extremely difficult. However, it can improve the possibility of a patient receiving specific early intervention to optimize neuroplasticity and prevent complications. General Movement Assessment (GMA) is being used to diagnose CP, that assist in identifying nerve issues that leads to CP. It is currently being carried out manually by a well-trained physician. The purpose of the present study is to compare the accuracy and precision levels, and processing times with respect to different frame rates in identifying circular movements. This study shows that the frame rate of a video is correlated with the precision of the model. The influence that the processing time has on the accuracy of identification is also studied. The highest level of accuracy (94.4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and precision (95.0%) was displayed with the increment of frame rate.

articleTitle: WECS Interfaced To Grid Through Matrix Converter Using MPC
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this paper a Model Predictive Control (MPC) technique is applied to a direct matrix converter which is used for interfacing of grid to a Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS). Certain LC filters are used along with direct matrix converter to obtain a constant power supply for grid. The paper addresses the work for a WECS with variable speed operation where the primary objective of control is to get constant sinusoidal voltage and constant power and frequency as required to the connected grid. MPC technique is adopted to modulate the matrix converter in order to produces constant and reliable power for grid with different wind speeds for WECS. With MPC, several different control objectives can be easily obtained such as common-mode voltage also the input power factor. The controller is observed for various conditions like variable wind speed, static loads and dynamic loads presented within the grid. The proposed technique for control is reliable, less complex, effective and relevant for application. Simulation study is performed for the proposed method and to verify the capability of the controlled scheme certain results are provided. The MPC technique can be used for micro-grid or smart building with smaller wind conversion systems.

articleTitle: Design Analysis and Performance of Elevated Ground Based Patch Antenna for WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents elevated ground microstrip patch antenna's performance assessment in terms of bandwidth, directivity and gain compared to a normal microstrip patch antenna. By inserting elevated ground instead of normal ground the characteristics such as gain, directivity, operating bandwidth and efficiency are improved at the resonance. The antenna has been designed and characterized for the resonance frequency of 2.4 GHz suitable for WLAN applications.

articleTitle: Optimization and Enhancement of Space Object Identification Algorithms and Implementation Using Deep Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Satellites are continuously launched by various countries for some expeditions. Satellites, after completing their work become nonfunctional and disintegrate in space, as debris continues to revolve in the space orbit. Now, these may collide with each other or with the fully functional satellite. This causes the formation of more debris. Hence, there is a huge possibility that these debris may harm the satellite. This may cost billions and the failure of new projects. The proposed work uses CNN model of the deep learning algorithm and its various applications to classify space objects as debris using light curves. This current work studies the different deep learning approaches and compares the result of their accuracies to suggest the best approach.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Gray-scale Image Compression Method Using Index-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Images consume more space when stored and use a lot of bandwidth during transmission. Hence, an image compression reduces storage space required, and time to transmit an image by making effective usage of bandwidth. In this paper, a simple image compression method using an index-based approach is proposed. This approach makes use of simple indices of an array to compress images. The context of nearby fifteen pixels is used, and the index for the current pixel is found. The indices are found for every pixel of an image. These indices are transformed and written into a transformed file. This transformed file is further compressed with Huffman compression to achieve a compressed file. Decompression uses a simple methodology to reconstruct the image. The pixel value is reconstructed using the index, and from previously reconstructed pixels of the image. The proposed algorithm provides high fidelity images at lower Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR). The results obtained from the proposed algorithm are compared with JPEG algorithm. At the same PSNR values, the quality of the reconstructed images by the proposed algorithm is comparable to that of the JPEG algorithm.

articleTitle: Illustration of Load Frequency Control of Hybrid Renewable System With Tuned PIDF Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents modelling of isolated hybrid renewable energy system (HRES). It consisting up of two renewable energy sources namely solar and wind, diesel generator set and flywheel energy storage. Different case scenario is take for analysing frequency change. Also, the efficient working of the diesel generator set at the time of peak load is also studied. The whole isolated grid system is optimised with PIDF controller in the feedback path for load frequency control. Moreover, the study model is simulated in MATLAB platform.

articleTitle: A Dipole Tag Antenna for Microwave Frequency RFID with Gain Enhancing Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This article introduces a half-wave dipole tag antenna for microwave frequency RFID applications with a gain enhancing method. The dipole antenna loaded with meander line is designed at 2.46 GHz with a concise size of 0.32λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>X 0.34λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>substrate, λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>being the free-space wavelength corresponding to the resonant frequency. To establish a conjugate impedance match between antenna and microchip, meander line dipole antenna uses T-match network as an integrated module. Both meandering and T-match techniques evolve into an adequate matching approach. A parasitic element is implemented in parallel with the main driven element in this way that without deforming the omnidirectional pattern, directive gain will increase. 105.43 % impedance bandwidth and 4.77 dBi alongwith other required parameters, the complete tag antenna is beneficial for RFID application.

articleTitle: Block-Wise Image Compression Using Major and Minor Diagonal Pixels
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The important role played by the data compression is in reducing the storage space required, and ensuring bandwidth utilization in efficient manner and low transmission delays. Image compression is also a part of data compression. Images contain important data that is to be transmitted or stored. The compression must not degrade the quality of the image, and should be acceptable. This paper presents simple, low complexity image compression algorithm. Algorithm scans the image in a raster san manner in terms of 4X4 blocks. Compression is achieved by the diagonally situated pixels and indices their surrounding pixels of the block. The mages produced by proposed algorithm are high fidelity images at low PSNR values. The results are comparable with standard algorithm results. The reconstructed image quality is better than JPEG images at same PSNR.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation and Comparative Analysis of Switched Mode Converter incorporating PID and Fuzzy Logic Control Topology
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Switched mode power electronic converters have variety of applications in industry, research, traction including electric vehicles due to their superior characteristics compared to linear power supplies. The paper aims at comparative performance analysis of conventional PID controller and Fuzzy Logic Controller for a prototype 50 Volt DC, 20 Amp switched mode power electronic converter application. Many electronic devices/equipment's require various DC voltage levels than that supplied by the battery. Switched mode converters needs to regulate its output voltage to lower voltage and must quickly respond to fast load and line variations/transients to keep the output voltage within a limited range without any undesired overshoot or undershoot. The design of high performance linear proportional integral controller for switched mode converter presents series of challenges due to non linear nature of the plant process. Fuzzy logic controller is mostly used in variety of industrial applications including use in domestic appliances and main tool of operation of fuzzy logic controller is membership function. It doesn't require any mathematical model for the plant process. In this paper linear proportional integral controller and non linear fuzzy logic controller have been proposed incorporating with switched mode converter. Both the controller design configurations have been simulated using software simulation tool. The simulation results shows the fuzzy logic controller has improved steady state as well as transient performance compared to conventional proportional integral controller under various simulated scenarios. The circuit simulation results have been presented in the paper including discussions on performance parameters of controller.

articleTitle: Detection of Cut Transition in Videos Using Optical Flow and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In our everyday lives, videos have become an immersive and interactive media of communications. The huge number of video makes it very hard to peruse and get the necessary data. Manual indexing and analyzing the contents of videos is time consuming process. The automatic detection of some events within the video is a clear option of this problem. The collection of frames or images from a single camera is referred to as a shot in a digital video sequence. The abrupt changes of shots from one scene to another are the determination of shot boundary. Shot detection is just one of the basic techniques for digital video analysis. The process of video shot detection is also considered as basic temporal segmentation which is needed as a pre-processing for video summary. The proposed research presents the detection of abrupt transition CUT with varied constrictions based on the Optical Flow Model and clustering techniques. We have used two different corner detectors FAST and ORB to determine Optical Flow from the sequence of Video. The characteristic of the flow determines the CUT transition from the video sequence. We then used the corner points as features and use clustering methods CLARANS and WARD to get the number of clusters, which eventually ascertain the number of CUT transition in the Video sequence. To verify the correctness of the method, we used two different features from corner points, location of the corner points and corner strength. Results obtain ascertain the number of shot transition. Finally we demonstrate our approach showing the conventional ELBOW method as conclusion of the procedures adopted. These algorithms have the higher efficiency to detect cuts in speedy scene changes in the video.

articleTitle: One-shot style transfer using Wasserstein Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: We propose an image style transfer method based on disentangled representation obtained with Wasser-stein Autoencoder. Style transfer is an area of image generation technique that generates an image that shows content taken from one image with a style taken from another image. While there are extensive researches in this area, most of them require some ‘training’ time to generate images with a specific style. The proposed method does not require training time since we train a versatile network that can be used for any style and content image. The network encodes images into disentangled latent variables that represent content and style. We can transfer image style by simply replacing style latent variables. We tested the proposed method with images from CelebA and confirmed that it can generate style transferred images.

articleTitle: Deep Intensified Archetypical CNN Approach for Hyper Spectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: To analyze remotely sensed images, Hyper Spectral Image Classification is playing a significant role. The latest works for HSI classification are based on the use of 2D CNN or 3D CNN alone. Due to complexity issues the use of 3D CNN is not suggested. To overcome this issue we are purposing a deep intensified archetypical 3D-2D neural net with the incorporation of maxpooling.
